title: The app won't connect to my radio
summary: The Meshtastic app cannot find the radio, pairing fails, or the connection will not start.

steps.question: Is the radio on and showing signs of life?
steps.help: Look for a lit screen or a blinking light. Some boards have a power switch or need a long press of the power button.

steps.title: Get the radio powered
steps.body: A flat battery is the most common reason a radio does not show up.
steps: Plug the radio into USB power and leave it for a few minutes.
Press the reset button once, or hold the power button, to start it.
If it still shows nothing on USB power, the firmware may not have flashed properly. Try the recovery steps in the flashing guide.

steps.question: Is Bluetooth on, and does the Meshtastic app have permission to use it?
steps.help: On Android the permission is called Nearby devices, and older Android versions also need Location turned on to scan. On iPhone, look under Settings, then Meshtastic.

steps.title: Turn on Bluetooth and allow the app
steps.body: The app cannot scan for radios without Bluetooth and its permissions.
steps: Turn on Bluetooth on your phone.
In the phone's settings, find the Meshtastic app and allow Bluetooth (Nearby devices on Android).
On older Android versions, also turn on Location.
Close the app completely and open it again.

steps.question: Does your radio appear in the app's list of devices?
steps.help: It is listed under a name like Meshtastic_1a2b when the app scans.

steps.title: Make the radio visible
steps.body: A radio that is on but not listed is usually connected to something else, or has its Bluetooth off.
steps: Hold the phone within a few feet of the radio.
Close anything else that might be connected to it: the app on another phone or tablet, or a browser tab with the web client. A radio accepts one Bluetooth connection at a time.
If you turned on WiFi on the radio, that turned Bluetooth off on most boards. Connect over USB and turn WiFi off again.

steps.question: Did pairing ask for a PIN, and accept the one you entered?
steps.help: A radio with a screen shows a six-digit PIN when you pair. A radio without a screen uses 123456.

steps.title: Forget the radio and pair again
steps.body: A half-finished pairing stays on the phone and blocks new attempts.
steps: In the phone's Bluetooth settings, find the radio and choose Forget or Unpair.
Pair again from inside the Meshtastic app, not from the phone's Bluetooth settings.
Enter the PIN on the radio's screen, or 123456 if it has no screen.

links.label: Pairing steps in the setup guide

steps.question: Are the app and the radio's firmware both up to date?
steps.help: Check the app in your phone's app store. An old app with new firmware, or the other way around, can fail to connect.

steps.title: Update the app and the firmware
steps.body: The app and the firmware are released together, and a large gap between them causes connection failures.
steps: Update the Meshtastic app from your app store.
Flash the current stable firmware over USB.
Forget the radio in the phone's Bluetooth settings and pair again.

steps.title: Ask in Discord
steps.body: This is beyond the usual causes. With the details below, someone can usually spot the problem.
include: Your phone model and its Android or iOS version
Your radio model and firmware version
How you are connecting: Bluetooth, USB or WiFi
Where exactly it stops, and any error text the app shows
